_about: Every change to how we make videos is a test here (owner 2026-11-27: if it works keep it, else roll back). factory/analyze.py judges each running test per platform: views at 72 h vs the 7 videos before it started, divided by the change on platforms the test doesn't touch (control), must be x1.10+ with seconds watched and skip/watch % no more than 15% worse; 3+ videos at 24 h under 60% of before = early harm stop. factory/experiments.py then keeps it or flips its `switch` values back automatically and sets needs_undo when `rollback` text needs the script run. Max 2 running per platform. status: running | kept | reverted | dropped. Videos carry the id in their job's "tests" list.

tests.change: YouTube title and opening headline lead with the surprising fact as a 'Why...' claim, search phrase kept in the title
tests.metric: YouTube views at 24 h above our 556 median
tests.note: Dropped early on 2026-11-22 (owner's call): early numbers negative (cooker whistle 286 at 72 h vs 1,404 before; YouTube 24 h 99-425 vs 556 target; IG 7.6-11.4 s vs 15 s target) and it ran mixed with the bold picture style, so no clean verdict. Make room for the reach tests.

tests.change: Scene 2 gives one real piece of the answer (first step of the chain) before teasing the rest; never a tease-only scene
tests.metric: Instagram seconds watched from 11 s to 15 s+, skip under 40%
tests.note: Dropped early on 2026-11-22 (owner's call): early numbers negative (cooker whistle 286 at 72 h vs 1,404 before; YouTube 24 h 99-425 vs 556 target; IG 7.6-11.4 s vs 15 s target) and it ran mixed with the bold picture style, so no clean verdict. Make room for the reach tests.

tests.metric: Instagram skip under 35%, Instagram seconds watched 15 s+, shares per 1k 2+, views at 72 h above the 1,404 median
tests.scope_note: Judged on Instagram + Facebook only from 2026-11-27: YouTube now gets its own cut (test 2026-11-27-youtube-cut).
tests.rollback: prompts/script.md + playbook: full video back to the pre-23-Nov length (60-89 s is fine, Prashant 2026-11-18; spoken words up to ~170), drop the 'send this to the friend who...' scene and caption line 3.

tests.note_2026_11_28: Prashant: the half-sentence loop ending sounded like the video was cut off. From 28 Nov the cut ends on a complete closing sentence plus a 1.5 s hold; video 1 (receipt) used the old ending.

tests.change: Instagram only: post the short 30-45 s cut (no quiz card, no shoutout, share line kept) with a caption that has no quiz and no ask to comment; Facebook keeps the full video with the quiz
tests.metric: Instagram only: views at 72 h above the 120 median of the 7 videos before (x1.10+), seconds watched not more than 15% worse, likes per 1k up
tests.rec: Prashant 2026-11-28 (chat): 'Instagram videos have gone for a toss. No likes, no new followers. Do something about it'
tests.why: Instagram breakouts all came before 13 Nov (2,135 / 1,253 / 602); since the quiz and 'comment A or B, first 3 right get a shoutout' started on 13 Nov, 0 of 14 videos passed 240 views, even fog lights (21 s watched, 29% skip) and two flush buttons (22 s). Meta's engagement-bait rules demote posts that ask for specific comments or reward them.
tests.note: Starts while short-share and trend-audio are still waiting for their 72 h verdicts (both have their 5 videos made); Prashant asked for action now.

tests.change: Facebook caption only: line 1 states the common wrong belief about the object in plain words, then the question (e.g. 'Most people think the bumps under a soda bottle bottom are just for looks. So why...?'). Instagram and YouTube captions unchanged.
